warnings: Do not wear contact lenses while using.
Keep out of the reach and sight of children.

steps.text: Use your Chloramphenicol 0.5% eye drops. Each time, put 1 drop into both eyes.
steps.text_en: Use your Chloramphenicol 0.5% eye drops. Each time, put 1 drop into both eyes.
steps.picture_prompt: A small eye drop bottle with a white cap standing on a table next to a simple pair of eyes
steps.say: Use your Chloramphenicol 0.5% eye drops. Each time, put 1 drop into both eyes.

steps.text: Use the drops 4 times a day. Do this for 5 days.
steps.text_en: Use the drops 4 times a day. Do this for 5 days.
steps.picture_prompt: A simple sun path across the sky showing four morning, midday, afternoon and evening scenes in a row
steps.say: Use the drops 4 times a day. Do this for 5 days.
Wash your hands. Take your time.

steps.picture_prompt: a person tilting their head back
steps.say: Tilt your head back. Take your time.

steps.text: Pull your lower eyelid down gently with a clean finger.
steps.text_en: Pull your lower eyelid down gently with a clean finger.
steps.picture_prompt: a finger gently pulling down a lower eyelid
steps.say: Pull your lower eyelid down gently with a clean finger. Take your time.

steps.text: Squeeze 1 drop into the gap. Do not let the bottle touch your eye.
steps.text_en: Squeeze 1 drop into the gap. Do not let the bottle touch your eye.
steps.picture_prompt: a drop falling from a bottle toward an eye
steps.say: Squeeze 1 drop into the gap. Do not let the bottle touch your eye. Take your time.

steps.text: Close your eye. Press a finger on the inside corner of your eye for about 1 minute.
steps.text_en: Close your eye. Press a finger on the inside corner of your eye for about 1 minute.
steps.picture_prompt: a person with closed eyes and a finger at the corner of one eye
steps.say: Close your eye. Press a finger on the inside corner of your eye for about 1 minute. Take your time.

steps.text: Wipe away extra liquid with a clean tissue.
steps.text_en: Wipe away extra liquid with a clean tissue.
steps.picture_prompt: a tissue wiping beside an eye
steps.say: Wipe away extra liquid with a clean tissue. Take your time.

steps.text: Do not wear contact lenses while you use these drops.
steps.text_en: Do not wear contact lenses while you use these drops.
steps.picture_prompt: A contact lens case with a clear red cross drawn over it
steps.say: Do not wear contact lenses while you use these drops. Take care with this one.

steps.text: Store the bottle in a fridge, between 2°C and 8°C.
steps.text_en: Store the bottle in a fridge, between 2°C and 8°C.
steps.picture_prompt: An open fridge with the eye drop bottle on a shelf, and a high cupboard with a child looking up from below
steps.say: Store the bottle in a fridge, between 2°C and 8°C. Take care with this one.

steps.text: Throw it away 28 days after opening.
steps.text_en: Throw it away 28 days after opening.
steps.picture_prompt: An open fridge with the eye drop bottle on a shelf, and a high cupboard with a child looking up from below
steps.say: Throw it away 28 days after opening. Take care with this one.

steps.text: Keep it out of the reach and sight of children.

steps.picture_prompt: An open fridge with the eye drop bottle on a shelf, and a high cupboard with a child looking up from below
steps.say: Keep it out of the reach and sight of children. Take care with this one.
